name: The Buried Mayor
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Ashfall Hollow: Cinderholt's mayor was buried at his desk when the ash came down, and now he has dug himself out of the old square to call the council to order. P1 'The Council Sits': a gavel cone, edicts in lines, and his Speech — a blast across the square; hide behind a buried chimney. The TOWN BELL (use it once) stuns him. P2 at 55% 'The Townsfolk': the ghosts of the town gather round him behind a ward — DEFEAT THE GHOSTS to drop it — and ash drifts settle where they fall. P3, a new health bar 'The Recall Vote': the square splits open (four of you stand on it to hold it shut), stone falls on everyone, and a get-in-close shockwave. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (a soak of 4). 3-5: playable, tight. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and ghosts by players enrolled; soak need = clamp(players/5, 2, 4).

onUse.say: The old town bell rings out over the square! The Mayor flinches as if it were the ashfall again.

pull: ORDER. ORDER! This council is in session.
A figure of grey stone climbs out of the square, still wearing a chain of office.
Who let all these people into the council square?
say.death: The Buried Mayor sits down heavily. 'Meeting... adjourned.'
say.reset: The Buried Mayor sinks back into the square, still talking.

enrage.say: THE COUNCIL IS DISSOLVED. SO ARE YOU.

soft.say: Ash starts to fall on the square again.

edict.name: Ash Edict
edict.say: He reads an edict — two lines of falling stone!

speech.name: The Speech
speech.say: The Mayor clears his throat for a SPEECH — get behind a chimney!

drifts.name: Ash Drifts
drifts.say: Ash falls on the square — and drifts where it lands.

split.name: The Square Splits
split.say: The square cracks under {target} — FOUR of you stand on it to hold it shut!

telegraphs.failSay: Not enough feet on the crack — the square caves in under everyone!

stonefall.name: Stonefall
stonefall.say: The town hall is falling on everyone — keep moving!

shockwave.name: Square Shockwave
shockwave.say: A shockwave rolls out of the square — get in close!

phases.name: The Townsfolk
phases.say: The townsfolk will attend! ALL of them!
phases.shieldDown: The last ghost fades — the Mayor stands alone!

onEnter.say: The ghosts of Cinderholt gather round the Mayor behind a ward. Kill the ghosts and the ash golem to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

ward.say: The ghosts of Cinderholt gather round the Mayor behind a ward. Kill the ghosts and the ash golem to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

phases.name: The Recall Vote
phases.say: A recall vote? On ME? The square will decide!

do.say: Every chimney is rubble. Nothing left to hide behind!
